author: Patri Sassi Juvera
text:
Last night when we got home to find  out septic tank was full and backing up.
I called several places today and wasn't happy with the time frame (Monday) the earliest. And the prices were exorbitant.
Then I called Eagerton Septic.
Not only the young lady was very polite , she went out of her way to have the gentleman to call me for a approximate time.
They came on time. Went right to work, and after digging up the lid.
They put it all back , you would never know anyone was there.
Great job.
I highly recommend this company.
Thank you,
P. Juvera

author: Charity Clark
text: Joe and Joey came out and were extremely helpful. They emptied our septic tank and gave us good advice about keeping a septic system healthy and working properly. I will definitely recommend them to anyone who has plumbing or septic tank needs.

author: Katherine Berry
text: Absolutely amazing company!  Excellent customer service over the phone and in person! When the pump guys came out they treated us like family, answered all the questions I had and even beeped the horn for my son. 😁 He is almost 4 and into big trucks so he got a kick out of that. I honestly couldn't have asked for a better company to do the job. Things were done in a timely manner, they didn't leave a mess and the price was lower than other companies. I will definitely be calling them again when needed and recommend them to everyone!

author: William Royals
text: I had called around for pricing for a septic pump out and was left on hold many times by others, Eagerton customer service answered promptly, was courteous and professional, provided a competitive price, and dispatched the crew next day, They were courteous, professional, and fast,

author: Janidsa Till
text: Shout out to Joey, very sweet and professional young man. He certainly went above and beyond my expectations. Hopefully I don’t need the service again, but if I do I will certainly call Eagertons.
